title: Protocol and Archive
author: Hazel Nystrom
blurb: Mara Yarrow, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
